title: Volt Albania Opposes TikTok Ban: A Hasty Decision That Undermines Freedom of Expression
description: 1. Banning TikTok Is Not the Right DecisionBanning a social platform like TikTok is an extreme measure that restricts freedom of expression, a fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution. TikTok, like any other platform, may host problematic content, but the responsibility lies in how it is used, not in its existence. title: Volt Albania: A New Wind in Albanian Politics?
description: Volt Albania is not just a political party, but a vision for a different Albania. title: One year after the terrorist attacks on Israel: choosing the side of human rights
description: A year ago today, more than a thousand terrorists from Hamas attacked Israel in the early morning, with thousands of victims, mostly civilians, and 251 hostages. The largest-ever terrorist attack on Israeli soil.This massacre destroyed what should have been scenes of joy: a music festival and families enjoying breakfast in their homes. Today we commemorate the victims of this terrible act and repeat the demand that the remaining hostages should be freed immediately. A cycle of traumaThis attack

title: Recording the first episode of the new TV program - Future made in Europe
description: Our pioneers at Volt Albania, with the help of the amazing team of TV Apollon today recorded the first episode of the new TV program "Future made in Europe. A program all about people in Europe sharing their experience and their stories. At Volt we already know how important Europe is, but we also know that there's room for improvement. title: The Volt Albania team is at the Volt General Assembly in Paris
description: At the general assembly Volters from all over Europe met up to discuss their future in Europe. Volt Albania was present as well to show our support and talk about the future of Albania.

title: Happy Europe Day
description: Today is the day for all Europeans were we celebrate celebrate peace and unity in Europe. A day very special to us Volters.

title: Europe country council 2022 in Italy
description: At Volt, nothing is more important than doing things together in Europe. We are not only from our own countries, we are Europeans. To get things done this means that we need to meet up and discuss what future we want to make in Europe and how to do it.We do this at our general assembly with all members, at meetups and today we also do that at our country council meeting.

title: The founding of Volt Albania
description: Volt Albania is founded today, it's time for something new in Albania. A new generation of politics.That's why Volt Albania was founded. We are here to bring a new way of doing things to Albania. A new way that has it's foundation in working together for a better world. For Albanians by Albanians, as Europeans.
